notes: Version 36.8: move your Virgin Media email to Gmail with an app password. If you can get one from the My Virgin Media app, Your Virgin email now checks and moves your mailbox with it - no browser window, nothing to install, and nothing for Virgin's security check to stop. And when the move is done, a printable change list: every company that emails your old address, the most important first, with a box to tick. Signed by 365 Techies Ltd.
